scripts.dev:browser: pnpm run copy-assets && NODE_ENV=development esbuild app/assets/*.ts app/assets/*.tsx --outbase=app/assets --outdir=public/assets --bundle --minify --splitting --format=esm --entry-names='[dir]/[name]' --chunk-names='chunks/[name]-[hash]' --sourcemap --watch --jsx-factory=h --jsx-fragment=Fragment
scripts.build: pnpm run build:browser && pnpm run build:worker
scripts.build:browser: pnpm run copy-assets && NODE_ENV=production esbuild app/assets/*.ts app/assets/*.tsx --outbase=app/assets --outdir=public/assets --bundle --minify --splitting --format=esm --entry-names='[dir]/[name]' --chunk-names='chunks/[name]-[hash]' --jsx-factory=h --jsx-fragment=Fragment
scripts.deploy: pnpm run build && wrangler deploy dist/worker.js
